mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that prompts central bank policy accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE has been above 5.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS declines fails to predict negative 60-day returns with a Rank IC below 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 days as industrial weakness signals an impending recession.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 100, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 650,000 units, it signals a weakening housing sector that drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 650.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicate labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE rising and PAYEMS falling fails to predict negative 60-day returns with a Rank IC below 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In zero-interest-rate policy regimes (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to liquidity trap concerns.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.25%, the S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 101.0, it signals manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 101.0.
